title: Dobbelt-Pi-hole canonical configuration
description: Private deployment input. Use tools/render_config.py for normalization and cross-instance validation; do not publish this file as browser configuration.

label.description: Nonblank display name. The renderer enforces at most 120 Unicode code points after trimming and rejects control characters and unpaired surrogates.

apiUrl.description: HTTP(S) API URL without credentials, query, fragment, escapes or dot segments. The renderer checks host/port validity and duplicate normalized URLs.
